notes.title: April 1st Special Update!
notes.content:
The April 1st update brings a new cool achievement! Hit some random guy's eggs on the roadside in "Episode 7: Ichi" and unlock this awesome achievement!

(Some minor text and translation fixes have also been applied.)

P.S.
Thank you to all the players — I love you so much! Thanks for leaving reviews, making videos, and helping to find bugs in the game and translations, as well as everyone who helped make these localizations happen! This April Fools' update is just a small joke, but it's not the last — I have ideas and plans to add a new ending! Thank you again for everything!

notes.title: A new episode celebrating the 2nd anniversary of Creepy Creepy Love!
notes.content:
On February 14, 2023, the original Creepy Creepy Love was released on Itch. We are grateful to all the players who have stayed with us since the game's original launch.

Additionally, Creepy Creepy Love is participating in the RPG Maker Festival, and from February 3, 2025, to February 10, 2025, the game will be available at a 30% discount!

The update adds:

 
     A new episode and a rival, Amy.
     A scene with me after the credits.
     5 new achievements.
     The ability to skip the opening scene by pressing any button.
     Music in the new game settings menu.


Thank you for staying with us!

notes.title: REBALANCE
notes.content:
The balance has been changed. Opponents have become weaker, timings between blows have been extended. Changes affected all opponents, especially Tsubaki.

It is now possible to change the difficulty after 3 defeats.

Fixed minor bugs and graphical artifacts.

P.S
As always, I listened to the advice of players and released a patch based on their advice and preferences. I hope you will appreciate the new game balance!

notes.title: Added saves and other changes.
notes.content:
Many players have asked to add me saves to the game. In my opinion the game is too short for this feature, but nevertheless I made in game saves before each episode.

Also, menu sounds have been replaced in the game.

Fixed a bug in the Beat em up mode when Rosa took a lot of damage.

notes.title: A small patch. (ง ื▿ ื)ว
notes.content:
In the training added paragraphs explaining the control and some features of the combat system:
[olist]

 During the fight, try to use different blows. If you often attack your opponent with the same punch, he will start to block.

 You can not only press the attack button, but also hold it down. In this case, the character will continue to attack until you release the button.
[/olist]
On easy difficulty in the Rose vs. Tsubaki fight, the rage scale is full from the start of the fight.

notes.title: Bug fixes and new difficulty.
notes.content:
Fixed bugs, and added a new easy difficulty.

Thank you for playing my game.

If you find a bug, please let me know in the game community.
